# U.S. House of Representatives
> Official website of the United States House of Representatives, with legislative activity, member information, committees, history, and public resources.

House.gov is the central public website for the House, providing access to Representatives, leadership, committees, floor and vote activity, educational materials, visitor information, media resources, employment, and administrative services.

## Core House Resources
- [Homepage](https://www.house.gov/): Main portal for House information, services, and legislative resources.
- [Representatives](https://www.house.gov/representatives): Directory of current House members by name, state, district, and party.
- [Leadership](https://www.house.gov/leadership): Information on House leadership roles and current leaders.
- [Committees](https://www.house.gov/committees): Directory of House standing and select committees.
- [Legislative Activity](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Access to floor proceedings, votes, schedules, and legislative calendars.
- [The House Explained](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained): Overview of House history, procedures, officers, and institutional structure.

## Representatives and Leadership
- [Representatives](https://www.house.gov/representatives): Browse all Representatives serving in the House.
- [Find Your Representative](https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative): Look up your Representative by ZIP code or state.
- [Leadership](https://www.house.gov/leadership): View current House leadership and leadership offices.
- [Member Data](https://www.house.gov/representatives): Official member directory and related House contact information.

## Committees
- [Committees](https://www.house.gov/committees): Central directory for House committees and committee websites.
- [Committee Repository](https://www.house.gov/committees#committee-repository): Access committee documents and archived committee materials.
- [Hearing Schedule](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Track committee-related legislative and hearing activity from House resources.

## Legislative Activity
- [Legislative Activity](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Main hub for House floor business and legislative information.
- [Bills This Week](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Current week’s House legislative agenda and bill consideration.
- [Floor Proceedings](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Follow House floor proceedings and related updates.
- [Votes](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Access recent House voting activity and floor actions.
- [Schedules](https://www.house.gov/legislative-activity): Review House calendars, schedules, and legislative timing information.

## House Structure and Process
- [The House Explained](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained): Introductory guide to the House and how it works.
- [Officers and Organizations](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained/officers-and-organizations): Learn about House officers and institutional offices.
- [The Legislative Process](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained/the-legislative-process): Overview of how legislation moves through the House.
- [The House in Session](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained/the-house-is-in-session): Explanation of House sessions and floor business.
- [History, Art & Archives](https://www.house.gov/the-house-explained/history-art-archives): Resources on House history, art, and archival collections.

## Visitors
- [Visitors](https://www.house.gov/visitors): Visitor information for the Capitol and House office buildings.
- [U.S. Capitol Visitor Center](https://www.house.gov/visitors/u-s-capitol-visitor-center): Plan visits through the Capitol Visitor Center.
- [Gallery Tickets](https://www.house.gov/visitors/gallery-tickets): Information about obtaining House gallery passes.
- [House Office Buildings](https://www.house.gov/visitors/house-office-buildings): Visitor guidance for House office building locations and access.
- [Directions and Maps](https://www.house.gov/visitors): Find visitor directions and navigation resources.

## Educators and Students
- [Educators and Students](https://www.house.gov/educators-and-students): Educational resources about Congress and the House.
- [Congressional App Challenge](https://www.house.gov/educators-and-students/congressional-app-challenge): Information about the House-supported student coding competition.
- [House Classroom Resources](https://www.house.gov/educators-and-students): Teaching materials for civics and congressional education.
- [Student Programs](https://www.house.gov/educators-and-students): Explore student-focused House learning opportunities.

## Media
- [Media](https://www.house.gov/media): News, press resources, and House media services.
- [Press Gallery](https://www.house.gov/media/press-gallery): Information for credentialed press covering the House.
- [Radio and TV Gallery](https://www.house.gov/media/radio-and-tv-gallery): Broadcast media resources for House coverage.
- [Photographers' Gallery](https://www.house.gov/media/photographers-gallery): Information for still photographers covering House proceedings.

## Doing Business with the House
- [Doing Business with the House](https://www.house.gov/doing-business-with-the-house): Administrative and procurement resources for vendors and partners.
- [Disbursements](https://www.house.gov/doing-business-with-the-house/disbursements): House expenditure and disbursement reporting resources.
- [Statements of Disbursement](https://www.house.gov/doing-business-with-the-house/statements-of-disbursement): Official statements detailing House spending and disbursements.
- [Procurement Opportunities](https://www.house.gov/doing-business-with-the-house): Information for businesses working with the House.
- [House Services](https://www.house.gov/doing-business-with-the-house): Administrative services and operational guidance.

## Employment and Careers
- [Employment](https://www.house.gov/employment): Central employment portal for House vacancies and career resources.
- [House Vacancy Announcements](https://www.house.gov/employment/positions-with-members-and-committees): Job listings with Members, committees, and House offices.
- [Positions in House Offices](https://www.house.gov/employment/positions-in-house-offices): Employment opportunities in House administrative offices.
- [Resume Bank](https://www.house.gov/employment/resume-bank): Submit credentials for House employment consideration.
- [Internships and Fellowships](https://www.house.gov/employment): Explore internship and fellowship-related opportunities.

## Related Legislative and Public Information
- [Congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov/): Federal legislative database for bills, resolutions, and congressional activity.
- [GovInfo](https://www.govinfo.gov/): Official government publications, including Congressional Record and House documents.
- [Clerk of the House](https://clerk.house.gov/): Official records, votes, and legislative information from the House Clerk.
- [Office of the Speaker](https://www.speaker.gov/): Official website of the Speaker of the House.
- [House Live](https://live.house.gov/): Live and archived video of House floor proceedings.
